_about_phone: Crissa on your phone (the phone packs, phone-packs/ in the library download) is the one part of Crissa not made with Grok Imagine: its anchor stills were generated with Google's Nano Banana and its moving loops with Google's Veo, from Crissa's own Grok Imagine portrait (CREDITS.md, 'Made with Nano Banana and Veo (Google)'). Each carries Google's invisible SynthID watermark, which Crissa never removes. Six of her phone flourishes (the crissa-phone-fl-* packs, added 2026-10-21 beside the Veo ones) were made with Wan 3.0 on the hosted wan.video service from her Nano Banana phone stills; they carry no tag, and each row records its original download's AI-generated-content label verbatim. The release adds these rows to FILM-PROVENANCE.json when it ships the phone module; no pack carries them.
